people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Ithamar
people.line: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
